metadata.title: Commit Durability as Completion Truth
metadata.description: Rework the current post-completion commit gate into CompletionGate vNext durability stages. Adds verified file existence, scope/writeSet coverage, commit execution, post-commit verification, LLM-authored but runtime-validated commit messages, per-agent git identity, dashboard truth fields, P26 reuse boundaries, rollout/migration, shared-file policy, circuit breaker behavior, and BLOCK recovery routing.
sourceDocuments: P44 Commit Gate Forensics — Comprehensive Bug Search Report
Commit Durability as Completion Truth — Vision Document

notes: v4.1.1 adapter compiles to executable lock.
ACCP remains an evidence/report protocol only.
This plan must reuse P26 infrastructure where present instead of duplicating GitRunner serialization, attempt-scoped artifacts, or managed validation runner.
Commit gate is removed as a separate post-completion concept and becomes CompletionGate vNext durability stages.

nonGoals: Do not solve the separate file-deletion RCA in this plan, except by adding guards that prevent false completion and destructive cleanup before durable verification.
Do not replace P26 systems that already exist; integrate/adapt them.
Do not make LLM output authoritative for gate verdicts, validation truth, mutation authorization, or evidence validation.

mission.text: Make durable git truth a required part of workspace completion. A mutation workspace cannot become COMPLETE until declared outputs exist, evidence and validation pass, scope/writeSet are verified, commit succeeds, and post-commit verification confirms expected files and identity.

hardRequirements.text: Standalone post-completion commit gate semantics are removed. Commit durability becomes a CompletionGate vNext stage.
A mutation workspace cannot transition to COMPLETE without a verified commit hash and post-commit file verification.
LLM commit composer may write explanation but must never be source of truth. Runtime fact packet and validator are authoritative.
LLM commit composer timeout, error, or invalid output must use bounded repair then deterministic fallback. LLM latency must not block durable completion indefinitely.
canEdit/writeSet mismatch is never silent. If mutation is unauthorized, block. If PlanSpec authority is ambiguous or legitimate output path is missing from allowedFiles, route to HIR.
Parallel shared-file mutation requires declared shared ownership. Undeclared concurrent writes to the same file block admission or route to HIR.
P26 infrastructure must be reused where present through adapters. Do not replicate GitRunner serialization, attempt-scoped artifacts, or managed validation runner if compatible P26 components exist.
BLOCK state must route deterministically to retry, repair, HIR, RCA, or RAR depending on stage failure class.

antiPatterns.text: Do not mark workspace COMPLETE before commit durability verification.
Do not silently exclude files from commits because they are outside canEdit/writeSet.
Do not let LLM commit message claims override runtime facts.
Do not duplicate P26 implementation if an adapter can reuse it.
Do not let dashboard show Verified Complete from runtime state alone.

rules: If two parallel workspaces write the same file and no shared owner/merge owner is declared, admission blocks before execution.
If a shared file is declared, exactly one workspace is the commit owner and other workspaces produce patch/evidence artifacts or route through integration queue.
If runtime detects same-file write drift during completion, route to NEEDS_HIR unless an automatic merge policy is explicitly declared.
Worktree isolation is necessary but not sufficient; writeSet ownership remains authoritative.
W0 must map P26 GitRunner serialization, attempt-scoped artifacts, and managed validation runner.
If P26 component exists and satisfies contract, build adapter instead of duplicating.
If P26 component partially satisfies contract, wrap and extend without changing public semantics unless required.
If P26 component is missing or incompatible, document gap and implement minimal P44.5-owned component.
If changed file is outside canEdit/writeSet and not declared shared, completion BLOCKS.
If declared output is outside allowedFiles but appears legitimate by PlanSpec intent, route to HIR to amend PlanSpec or allowedFiles.
If generated artifact is outside allowedFiles and non-critical, emit WARN only when explicitly configured as safe generated artifact.

waves.title: Compatibility, Policy Freeze, and Migration Map
waves.description: Resolve the known design gaps before implementation: P26 overlap, shared-file policy, LLM circuit breaker, recovery routing, migration/backfill strategy, and canEdit mismatch semantics.

waves.title: Contracts and Verdict Types
waves.description: Define CompletionGate vNext types, stage verdicts, truth statuses, commit candidate set, and agent completion claim contracts.

waves.title: Durability Stages
waves.description: Implement declared output existence, evidence/validation adapters, scope/writeSet coverage, commit preparation, commit execution, and post-commit verification stages.

waves.title: LLM Commit Message Composer and Git Identity
waves.description: Add LLM-authored but runtime-validated commit messages, deterministic trailers, timeout/circuit breaker, fallback renderer, and per-workspace git identity.

waves.title: State Routing, Read Model, and Dashboard Truth
waves.description: Wire deterministic BLOCK recovery routing and expose runtime/implementation/validation/durability status fields to the read model and dashboard.

waves.title: Destructive Operation Guard and Migration Backfill
waves.description: Prevent cleanup/discard/reset/worktree removal from destroying unpreserved output and add backfill for verifiedComplete over legacy COMPLETE workspaces.

waves.title: Gauntlets and Promotion
waves.description: Add end-to-end gauntlets for fake complete, missing declared file, canEdit/writeSet exclusion, commit failure, invalid LLM commit message, shared-file conflict, and destructive cleanup preservation.

workspaces.title: P26 Compatibility, Shared-File Policy, and Recovery Routing Freeze

instructions.text: Map P26 components and decide adapter/reuse/extend/implement for each overlapping stage.
Freeze shared-file policy: undeclared parallel mutation blocks; declared shared file requires single commit owner or integration owner.
Freeze LLM commit composer circuit breaker: timeout 8s, one repair, deterministic fallback, LLM never authority.
Freeze BLOCK recovery routing table by stage failure class.

acceptanceCriteria.title: P26 overlap map exists
acceptanceCriteria.text: Every overlapping P26 capability is classified as reuse, adapter, extend, or missing.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Shared-file policy is explicit
acceptanceCriteria.text: The plan declares how parallel same-file mutation is blocked or routed.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Recovery routing is deterministic
acceptanceCriteria.text: Every CompletionGate vNext stage failure maps to retry, repair, HIR, RCA, RAR, or fallback.

instructions.text: Define CompletionGateVNextVerdict, StageVerdict, AgentCompletionClaim, VerifiedReality, CommitCandidateSet, and WorkspaceTruthStatus.
Types must represent runtimeStatus, implementationStatus, validationStatus, durabilityStatus, verifiedComplete, blockers, warnings, and route recommendation.

acceptanceCriteria.title: CompletionGate vNext types exist
acceptanceCriteria.text: Core verdict and truth status types compile and are tested.

acceptanceCriteria.title: VerifiedComplete cannot be runtime-only
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove verifiedComplete requires implementation, validation, and durability statuses.

instructions.text: Implement orchestrator that runs stages in deterministic order and returns pass/warn/block/HIR/retry/repair routes.
Adapter must allow warning mode and blocking mode for rollout.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Stage orchestrator implemented
acceptanceCriteria.text: CompletionGate vNext can run configured stages and aggregate verdicts.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Warning/blocking mode supported
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove rollout mode can warn without blocking and strict mode blocks.

workspaces.title: Declared Output and Evidence Verification Stages

instructions.text: Block completion when declared output or PlanSpec-required output is missing.
Reuse existing EvidenceLedger where possible and block missing/stale/unresolved evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Missing declared output blocks
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove a workspace claim with nonexistent file cannot be COMPLETE.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Evidence gap blocks
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove missing evidence cannot pass strict completion.

workspaces.title: Scope, WriteSet, Commit Candidate, and Commit Execution Stages

instructions.text: canEdit/writeSet exclusions must produce block or HIR, never silent exclusion.
Commit execution must happen before workspace COMPLETE and must use P26 GitRunner if compatible.
Commit failure returns stage block and cannot leave workspace COMPLETE.

acceptanceCriteria.title: canEdit mismatch not silent
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove out-of-scope mutation blocks or routes to HIR.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Commit failure blocks
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove git commit failure prevents COMPLETE.

instructions.text: Verify commit hash exists, author identity matches, required trailers exist, expected files are in commit, and no expected output remains untracked.
Post-commit verification failure blocks COMPLETE and routes to NEEDS_REPAIR.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Expected files verified in commit
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove missing expected file in commit blocks completion.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Commit metadata verified
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove required author/trailer metadata is checked.

workspaces.title: LLM Commit Message Composer, Validator, and Fallback

instructions.text: Composer receives runtime fact packet and may only produce prose. Validator rejects invented files, tests, broad pass claims, wrong scope, and missing body.
Circuit breaker uses 8s timeout, one repair attempt, then deterministic fallback. Fallback must not block durable completion when runtime facts are valid.

acceptanceCriteria.title: LLM hallucination rejected
acceptanceCriteria.text: Validator rejects messages that mention files or tests not in verified facts.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Timeout fallback works
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove composer timeout produces deterministic fallback message.

workspaces.title: Git Actor Identity and Structured Trailers

instructions.text: Each commit must use explicit per-workspace user.name and user.email via git -c or equivalent GitRunner config.
Commit trailers include Pi-Plan, Pi-Workspace, Pi-Agent, Pi-Completion-Gate, Pi-Commit-Durability, Pi-Validation, and Pi-Generated-By.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Per-workspace git identity exists
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove identity is generated deterministically for plan/workspace/agent.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Required trailers generated
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove required trailers are present and runtime-controlled.

workspaces.title: BLOCK Recovery Routing and Transition Integration

instructions.text: Implement deterministic mapping from stage failure to RETRYABLE_BLOCKED, NEEDS_REPAIR, NEEDS_HIR, NEEDS_RCA, NEEDS_RAR, or fallback-used status.
Commit failure cannot leave workspace COMPLETE; it must route according to recovery table.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Stage failure routing implemented
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests cover every stage failure route in the frozen recovery table.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Commit failure not complete
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove commit failure cannot result in COMPLETE state.

workspaces.title: Workspace Truth Read Model and Dashboard Fields

instructions.text: Expose runtimeStatus, implementationStatus, validationStatus, durabilityStatus, verifiedComplete, commitHash, verifiedFiles, blockers, warnings.
Dashboard must not render Verified Complete from runtime complete alone.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Truth fields exposed
acceptanceCriteria.text: Read model returns separate runtime, implementation, validation, and durability status fields.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Dashboard false complete prevented
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove runtime complete with missing commit renders durability failed, not verified complete.

instructions.text: Guard destructive operations by preserving diff/snapshot/event before checkout/reset/clean/worktree removal.
Block destructive operation if workspace output is not durably committed and preservation failed.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Destructive operations guarded
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove checkout/reset/worktree removal require preservation or block.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Uncommitted output not silently destroyed
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove uncommitted workspace output is preserved or HIR-blocked before deletion.

rollback.notes: Rollback guard and integration changes only.

workspaces.title: Legacy COMPLETE Backfill and Rollout Mode

instructions.text: Add retroactive verifiedComplete computation for legacy COMPLETE workspaces without mutating historical state.
Support rollout modes: off, shadow, warn, block_strict_plans, block_all_stable_3.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Legacy complete backfill exists
acceptanceCriteria.text: Read model can compute verifiedComplete for old runtime-complete workspaces as unknown/failed/passed without rewriting history.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Rollout modes implemented
acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests prove warning mode and strict blocking mode behave differently.

instructions.text: Add gauntlets for fake complete, missing declared output, untracked expected output, canEdit exclusion, commit failure, post-commit missing file, invalid LLM commit message, composer timeout, shared-file conflict, and destructive cleanup preservation.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Fake complete gauntlet blocks
acceptanceCriteria.text: A workspace that claims files without creating them cannot become verified complete.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Commit failure gauntlet blocks
acceptanceCriteria.text: A workspace with simulated commit failure cannot become verified complete.

acceptanceCriteria.title: LLM fallback gauntlet passes safely
acceptanceCriteria.text: Composer timeout uses fallback and still produces valid audited commit message.

rollback.notes: Rollback gauntlet tests and reports only.

instructions.text: Produce ACCP IPR, TVR, and PRR artifacts summarizing implementation, validation, open risks, rollout mode, and promotion decision.
Final PRR must explicitly state whether system score is at least 8/10 and what remains for 9/10+.

acceptanceCriteria.title: ACCP reports exist
acceptanceCriteria.text: IPR, TVR, PRR are written as ACCP v2.0 YAML source files.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Promotion decision explicit
acceptanceCriteria.text: Final report states promote/hold decision and remaining risks.

modes.meaning: Verdicts computed and logged but do not affect completion.
Dashboard/read model show warnings, but completion remains legacy-compatible.
P44/P45/stable_3 strict plans block on vNext failures.
All stable_3 plans use vNext blocking semantics.
